create_STBReader_training: create an STBReader instance in training mode to load hand pose data from the STB dataset
create_STBReader_evaluation: create an STBReader instance in evaluation mode to load test sequences for hand pose estimation
get_data_dict: get a TensorFlow data dictionary with image crops, keypoints, and PAF tensors from STBReader
review_STBReader_init: review the STBReader class constructor that loads pickled STB dataset and registers 3D hand tensors
test_STBReader_pipeline: test the STBReader pipeline by running a TensorFlow session and visualizing 2D and 3D hand keypoints
